revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a broad factory corridor with safety rails, distant machinery, and a clean matte concrete industrial floor under warm practical interior lighting. Front-oblique view at medium distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. A tall adult with a broad build wearing a reflective work vest over subdued gray and olive neutral clothing is clearly visible, sitting on one bent leg with the other leg extended, hips low but torso clearly non-horizontal. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, not cinematic or advertising. Include a cart near one edge and ample negative space around the subject. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
